title: Keep indented sub-items indented in PDF, DOCX and HWPX exports
target_user: The repository operator who submits 개조식 proposals and reports to public agencies
observed_problem: Korean public documents show hierarchy by indenting sub-items (1. → 가. → 1)). The shared Markdown parser strips leading whitespace, so in the 2026-10-21 proposal export every 가. item sat flush left under its 1. item in PDF, DOCX and HWPX, and the hierarchy was lost.

evidence.observation: The export of the synthetic proposal rendered indented 가. items without indentation.
Paragraph and list blocks keep only the stripped text.
Each lower item level moves two half-width spaces (one Hangul character) to the right of its parent.
The operator told the session to continue with the plan, whose next listed item was this indentation.

current_workaround: Indent sub-items by hand in Hangul or Word after export.
desired_outcome: Paragraphs and list items keep their Markdown indentation level in every export, one Hangul character per level.
acceptance_criteria: parse_markdown_blocks records an indent level for indented paragraphs and list items (two spaces or half a tab per level, at most four) and leaves blocks without indentation unchanged.
PDF renders each level as a 1em left margin, DOCX as a left indent of one font size, and HWPX as two half-width spaces.
Existing exports without indentation are byte-for-byte unaffected in their block structure.

excluded_effects: Call any provider or external service
separate_approval_required_for: Commit, push, pull request and merge

local_verification.proves: Indent parsing and rendering in the three formats; exact run evidence is recorded in the design spec.

decision.rationale: The operator told the session on 2026-10-21 to continue with the plan whose next item was sub-item indentation found in the proposal export. Rendering only; no external effects.
